BREAKING: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 just beat GPT Realtime on VulcanBench across both text and voice. ⚡🎙️

Across 200 held-out questions, Grok achieved 99% accuracy in text while also delivering stronger performance on the same questions when spoken.

What stands out most is the voice performance: Grok retains almost all of its accuracy while handling spoken questions and completing responses dramatically faster.

Grok isn't just improving at voice — it's becoming a powerful real-time AI that can listen, reason, and respond incredibly fast.

Starlink has surpassed 11,000 satellites in orbit. 🛰️🚀

Starlink’s satellite count has grown rapidly over just a few years:

• 2018 — 2
• 2019 — 122
• 2020 — 892
• 2021 — 1,791
• 2022 — 3,373
• 2023 — 5,267
• 2024 — 6,897
• 2025 — 9,387
• 2026 — 11,003*

From just 2 satellites in 2018 to more than 11,000 today. 🌍⚡
@elonmusk

BREAKING: Banglalink has asked regulators to approve the commercial launch of Starlink Direct to Cell in Bangladesh. 🇧🇩🛰️

The request comes after Banglalink successfully completed a two-month trial of the service.

The initial rollout would support SMS and light data, helping connect remote islands and communities beyond traditional cell-tower coverage.

If approved, Starlink Direct to Cell could bring basic connectivity to some of Bangladesh’s hardest-to-reach areas.

Starship Ship 40 has been recovered after 24 days at sea. 

After surviving reentry and achieving Starship’s first intact ocean splashdown in the Indian Ocean, Ship 40 is now in sheltered waters near Christmas Island for engineering analysis.

A major step toward proving Starship can survive, recover, and eventually fly again.
